text:
marta: quick idea — add an "echo-run" mode for runtime config applies: apply to a tiny shadow cohort, emit an auditline + telemetry snapshot, and auto-revert if error-rate or latency spike crosses threshold. want to sketch console UX before I file the RFC

sam: sounds useful. can you say more about 'auditline'? is that just a log entry or a structured event we can surface in the console?

marta: structured event. fields: config_id, actor, before/after diff, cohort_pct, ttl, metrics_snapshot_id, trigger_policy (manual/auto), reason. want it queryable in the config timeline and linked to the alerting dashboard

deen: º thinking about thresholds — auto-revert on 5xx rate increase > 1.5x baseline OR 95th latency +30% for 5m. also need a cooldown so repeated flaps don't cascade.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: note: any auto-revert must be annotated with the operator id and correlation id for postmortem.

jules: console UX: show an active 'echo-run' card next to the config change with a progress bar, live metrics sparkline, and two buttons: Pause and Revert. clicking Pause should stop additional cohort expansion but keep telemetry collection.

ash: question: how do we surface this to teams that rely on reserved quota buckets? if shadow traffic uses capacity it could mess quotas. we should route shadow to a separate, cheap pool or simulate requests without counting toward quota.

marta: good catch. design: shadow cohort traffic goes to 'shadow-mode' routing that either 1) hits a canary VM pool with isolated quota OR 2) runs via request-replay (no billing) depending on customer setting. console option: "Charge shadow traffic: yes/no"

lina-pm: for product acceptance criteria: 1) UI shows auditline and live metrics, 2) auto-revert works within 2m of threshold, 3) operator can opt-out of auto-revert per-change, 4) shadow traffic doesn't affect customer quotas by default.

sam: implementation notes: backend will need a new ConfigApply type with state {PENDING, ECHO_RUNNING, ECHO_FAILED, APPLIED}. telemetry side: emit snapshot_id at echo start, then emit delta events. suggest using existing rollout metrics instrumentation but tag with echo_run=true.

deen: can we reuse the existing quota-exempt flag? add a new routing header X-Shadow-Mode: replay|isolated. forwarding proxies should honor it. need a migration plan for older proxies.

jules: small UI quirk — when a change is auto-reverted, we should show a collapsed diff with reason + link to the metrics snapshot; and an affordance to re-run the echo with slightly different params.

marta: API draft (rough):

```
POST /runtime/configs.apply
{
  "config_id": "route_quota_v2",
  "apply_mode": "echo",          // echo | roll | instant
  "cohort_pct": 0.5,
  "ttl_secs": 600,
  "auto_revert_policy": {
    "enabled": true,
    "error_rate_mult": 1.5,
    "p95_latency_pct": 1.3,
    "window_secs": 300
  },
  "charge_shadow": false
}
```

ops-bot: infra-note: we should emit a single correlation header: X-Config-Trace: cfg-<sha>-<nonce>. it will help tying logs -> traces -> auditline.

ash: also need quota accounting story for Dedicated customers — prefer "replay" mode that doesn't consume GPU time but still exercises path via a lightweight simulation. ops infra will have to opt-in.

sam: owner proposal: runtime-api (sam) for API surface, rollout/telemetry (deen) for thresholds + metrics, console (jules) for UX. marta to file RFC and include acceptance criteria from lina.

marta: filed: https://r.reddoc/internal/rfc/echo-run-2026 — PTAL. putting a quick checklist here: 1) schema for auditline 2) routing header + proxy compatibility 3) telemetry tagging & snapshot id 4) console card mockups 5) auto-revert safe defaults 6) e2e smoke test plan.

lina-pm: timeline ask: minimal alpha (APIs + backend + basic card) in 3 sprints, then close loop w/ SRE for Dedicated quota handling.

jules: small nit — show an estimated cost delta in the card when charge_shadow=true so teams don't accidentally rack bills.

ash: ops-bot suggests adding a guard: enrollments per org limited to 2 concurrent echo_runs to avoid noisy experiments.

marta: noted. I'll add that to RFC. any objections to taking this into design->proto this week?

deen: no objections. I'll draft the threshold config as a proto and add to telemetry PR.

sam: ok by me. I'll stub the API and add a lint rule for apply_mode values.

ash: 👍

jules: adding UI task to my board.

marta: thanks all — will ping again once RFC has the first draft updates. :handshake:
